WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity,
    SUM(derived_product_cost) as total_cost,
    SUM(derived_total_cost) as total_total_cost
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) as overall_avg_qty
  FROM invoice_stats
  WHERE avg_quantity IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_invoices AS (
  SELECT 
    i.invoice_number,
    i.avg_quantity,
    CASE 
      WHEN i.total_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND i.total_total_cost != 0 
      THEN (i.total_cost - i.total_total_cost) / i.total_total_cost
      ELSE NULL
    END as cost_ratio,
    i.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg_qty as qty_difference
  FROM invoice_stats i
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE i.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg_qty
)
SELECT 
  invoice_number,
  avg_quantity,
  cost_ratio,
  qty_difference
FROM filtered_invoices
ORDER BY qty_difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
